## Positioning

Mojeeb turns rough ideas, useful information, and overlooked problems into clear, buildable products across AI, SaaS, developer tools, and Web3.

Confirmed portfolio claim: built and shipped 40+ products, tools, experiments, and platforms across 70 repositories. The portfolio distinguishes active products from paused work, hackathon builds, experiments, cultural builds, and inactive archives.

## Selected work

- BlindspotLab - https://blindspotlab.xyz - Productized build studio; founded by Mojeeb.
- Arcapush - https://arcapush.com - High-signal discovery platform for serious solo builders; 146 indexed products as of July 28, 2026.
- StackBrief - https://stackbrief.peerfix.dev - Open-source, local-first CLI for source-cited repository analysis; 500+ downloads as of July 2026.
- Revel - https://tryrevel.xyz - Website and product audit SaaS with an MCP-powered interactive agent capability.
- SiteHook - https://sitehook.run - SaaS for freelancers, studios, agencies, and solo builders; evolved from an internal BlindspotLab tool.
- Capself - https://capself.co - Personal Development Operating System with four Paystack subscription tiers.
- Whate - https://whate.app - Meal-discovery and meal-planning product with 10,516 meals in the July 2026 snapshot.
- Admon - https://admon.peerfix.dev - Web3 builder-identity and GitHub-credential product.

NAGIMU and CommitCar are confirmed parts of Mojeeb's build history, but the current build index does not confirm public URLs for them. No public URLs should be inferred.
